prompt:
A single warning icon illustration, centred, on a completely flat plain background of the exact deep teal green colour #013237. The object beneath the prohibition sign: a beer bottle and a cocktail glass standing side by side, the bottle in persimmon orange with a bone cream label and the glass in bone cream with a chartreuse drink in it, sitting directly above a simple chartreuse wavy water line to mean alcohol and swimming together. Simple, bold.

STYLE: flat vector silkscreen art with VERY BOLD heavy uniform dark outlines, the weight of a screenprinted poster. No gradients, no soft shading, no drop shadows, only flat fills and a faint even print grain. Simple, bold and instantly readable as a warning icon, drawn for adults rather than for a nursery.

Over the object, a bold PERSIMMON ORANGE prohibition sign: a thick open circle with a single thick diagonal bar running from upper left to lower right across the object. The circle and bar are persimmon orange with a dark outline, drawn on top so the object stays visible beneath.

Colours, strictly and only: deep teal green background #013237, bone cream, persimmon orange, chartreuse, and very dark green-black outlines. No other colour.

The subject is CENTRED with generous empty margin on all four sides — it must not touch or be cut off by any edge. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no human faces, no border, no frame.
